deferral_rationale: Round-7 reconcile: signed mean_cos_to_U1 IS the persisted-reference convention the plan anchors to ('the convention every prior threshold in this issue used', §3). Verified against the 9 reference SVD JSONs: they store ONLY the signed field (no abs field exists), the plan's quoted reference points (marker 0.550-0.713 = stored 0.5504/0.5871/0.7134; plain 0.954-0.980) are exactly the signed values, and signed==abs on all 9 cells (zero negative per-persona cosines), so the plan's '|cos|' notation is numerically degenerate with signed on every number used to register the thresholds. svd_summary sign-fixes U1 (svd_direction_constancy.py:120-123) so signed is stable, and the analysis persists BOTH mean_cos_to_U1 and mean_abs_cos_to_U1 for bands-vs-cells like-for-like comparison (issue552_contrastive_2x2_analysis.py:126-127,:166-167) — any future signed-vs-abs divergence is detectable post-hoc. Standing recommendation (non-binding): analyzer quotes both fields for the held-out-9 subpanel and flags any cell where the two straddle a band edge.
